purpose: Compose shared-frontier freshness, campaign checkpoint identity, bound V1 loop integrity/replay, branch-loop alignment and successor handoff into one read-only cold-resume receipt.
algorithm: read and validate the expected campaign state
require the campaign state path to be at expected_checkpoint_head
refresh shared Git state and require shared_frontier_verified
re-read campaign state after refresh and HOLD if state/checkpoint moved
require campaign checkpoint ancestry to current Git HEAD
resolve the selected branch and require a bound V1 loop
resume the bound loop without emitting its self-prompt
replay-verify the full loop receipt/prompt/chain history
require loop checkpoint ancestry to current Git HEAD
compare campaign-stored loop identity to freshly observed loop identity
return SYNC_BRANCH_REQUIRED on any bound-loop drift rather than mutating
surface HANDOFF_AVAILABLE only for an aligned COMPLETE loop with a valid successor baton
non_mutations: does not execute a steering-ledger action
does not mint scheduler readiness or execution authority
